Class DessertItem

java.lang.Object
restaurant.model.MenuItem
restaurant.model.DessertItem
public class DessertItem extends MenuItem
Represents a dessert menu item with a dessert type and selectable serving size.

  • Constructor Details

    • DessertItem

      public DessertItem(int itemId, String name, double basePrice, String dessertType)
      Creates a dessert with a regular serving and no size surcharge.
      Parameters:
      itemId - the positive identifier for this item
      name - the dessert's name
      basePrice - the finite, nonnegative starting price
      dessertType - the dessert's type; must not be null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the shared item data or dessert type is invalid

  • Method Details

    • setServingSize

      public void setServingSize(String servingSize, double additionalPrice)
      Selects the serving size and its additional charge.
      Parameters:
      servingSize - the serving size, either Regular or Large
      additionalPrice - the finite, nonnegative surcharge
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the size or surcharge is invalid
